brief:
**BLUF:** Tazewell County approved a new countywide fire company roster and a home purchase for an opioid recovery center using settlement funds. Bluefield WV police released a bench warrant list, while a vehicle fire briefly closed lanes on I-77 southbound in Mercer County before reopening. Wind advisories and a high wind warning remain in effect across the core area through Sunday morning.

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Tazewell County, VA:** No new arrests or major incidents reported in the last 24 hours. A man reported missing in Tazewell County on Oct. 8 was found safe.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-54/)

**Bluefield, WV (Mercer County):** The Bluefield West Virginia Police Department released a bench warrant list on Oct. 7 (updated/reported Oct. 9) from Bluefield City Municipal Court. The list includes individuals wanted for offenses such as obstructing an officer, DUI, destruction of property, assault, drug paraphernalia, possession of a controlled substance, and prostitution (not a complete list; individuals may turn themselves in at the department). Named on the list: Donald Jones (Welch, WV), Zachary Barnes (Huntington, WV), Michael Ferguson (Berwind, WV), Christopher Sesco (Bluefield, VA), Rebecca Stevens (Cedar Bluff, VA), Billie Howery (Tazewell, VA), Travis Whitt (Tazewell, VA), Earl Burnette (North Tazewell, VA), Amanda Arrington (North Tazewell, VA), Crystal Hall (Falls Mills, VA), Stepherd Owens (Richlands, VA), Michael Winters (Bishop, VA), and others.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-54/)

**Bluefield, WV (Mercer County):** Hallie Graham, wanted on charges including attempted first-degree murder, three counts of wanton endangerment, and malicious assault in connection with a shooting at Wild Riders Saloon, was arrested in Myrtle Beach, SC, and will be extradited to West Virginia.[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/bluefield-attempted-murder-suspect-reportedly-arrested-in-south-carolina/article_f73df7e4-1b7b-42bf-9242-53d58ca4caea.html)

**Mercer County, WV:** A Mercer County man faces two domestic violence felonies (reported Oct. 8).[[2]](https://www.wvnews.com/news/wvnews/bluefield-attempted-murder-suspect-reportedly-arrested-in-south-carolina/article_f73df7e4-1b7b-42bf-9242-53d58ca4caea.html)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours meeting priority thresholds.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Tazewell County, VA:** The Tazewell County Board of Supervisors unanimously approved the roster for a new countywide fire company at its October meeting to improve coordination, resources, and support for firefighters; stations remain in communities with cross-training emphasis. The new department begins serving unincorporated areas Oct. 15.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)

**Mercer County, WV:** Lanes on I-77 southbound reopened after a vehicle fire (reported Oct. 9).[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core area (Tazewell County VA; Mercer, McDowell WV; Buchanan, Russell, Smyth VA; others):** Wind Advisory in effect until 11:00 a.m. EDT Oct. 11 for Tazewell, Smyth, Grayson, Mercer, Summers, Western Greenbrier, Dickenson, Buchanan, McDowell, Wyoming, and other listed counties (issued by NWS Blacksburg VA and Charleston WV). High Wind Warning until 8:00 a.m. EDT Oct. 11 for Russell and Washington counties (NWS Morristown TN). No power outages, flooding, or road closures reported beyond the I-77 incident.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Tazewell County Zoning Board of Appeals voted unanimously to recommend a 9-month moratorium on data center development (until ~July 28, 2027) to allow time for ordinance development; proposal advances to Land Use Committee (Oct. 13 meeting) then Board. Tazewell County School Board public hearing on interim Northwestern District appointment set for Oct. 12 at 7:15 p.m. at Tazewell County Career and Technical Center.[[4]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/08/tazewell-county-zoning-board-moves-recommend-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell County, VA:** Board of Supervisors approved purchase of a home and 12 acres near Cavitt’s Creek Park/Lake Witten (nearly $500,000 from opioid settlement funds) for A Hope and Future Ministries to operate a 12-bed women’s opioid recovery center.[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/07/tazewell-county-buys-home-opioid-recovery-center/)

**Bluefield, WV / McDowell County, WV:** Bluefield State University professor received $370,000 funding for cancer treatment research. Cal Ripken Sr. Foundation and T.C. Energy partnering to launch STEM Centers at four McDowell County elementary schools.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)

**Richlands, VA (Tazewell County):** Residents face rising utility bills tied to generator debt.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Tazewell County Fire Prevention Parade: Oct. 10 at 6:00 p.m., starting at Tazewell High School along Fincastle Turnpike/Main Street/Fairground Road/Riverside Drive/Dunford Avenue.[[6]](https://woay.com/tazewell-county-celebrating-fire-prevention-month-with-annual-fire-prevention-parade-on-october-10/)
- Tazewell County School Board public hearing on school board appointment: Oct. 12, 7:15 p.m.
- Wind advisories/high wind warning continue through Sunday morning.
- Town of Tazewell Kids Fishing Day: Oct. 10.[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)
- 108th Veterans Day parade plans announced for Welch (McDowell County).[[3]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-establishes-new-fire-company/)
